title: kirolos.dev begins
summary: A personal portfolio begins taking shape as a long-form record rather than a conventional résumé page.
description: The portfolio starts with a time-proportional personal history: milestones appear according to their actual month and year, reveal themselves as the visitor scrolls, and expand into deeper context instead of reducing a life to a flat list of achievements.
detailParagraphs: The first portfolio system is intentionally data-driven. Timeline entries live in a content file rather than being written into the React component, so the chronology can grow without changing the timeline implementation.

On desktop, the deeper milestone window expands through hover and keyboard focus. On touch devices, the same information opens through an explicit tap so the interaction remains natural on each device class.
